public_holidays: No state-only statutory public holidays: Austria's public holidays are national and are on Austria's record.
culture-cycles.note: The patron-saint day is a school holiday in this state. The ministry lists it apart from the statutory public holidays, so do not assume shops or businesses close; the ministry page does not say.

laws.rule: Tyrol's stay levy (Aufenthaltsabgabe) is EUR 2.60 per person per night in accommodation (about A$4.13 at EUR 0.6293 per A$1, RBA 30 Oct 2026), section 6(1) of the Tiroler Aufenthaltsabgabegesetz 2003. The state government can set up to EUR 5 for a tourism association's area by ordinance (section 6(2)), and may vary it by season and area. Stays by people up to the end of the year they turn 15 are exempt (section 4).
laws.heading: Tiroler Aufenthaltsabgabegesetz 2003, paragraphs 4 and 6
